{{Short description|Educational Toy}}
[[File:Attribute blocks.png|thumb|A set of 60 attribute blocks]]
'''Attribute blocks''', also called '''logic blocks''', are [[Manipulative (mathematics education)|mathematical manipulatives]] used to teach [[logic]].
Each [[toy block|block]] in a set has a unique combination of four attributes, namely size, color, shape, and thickness.<ref name="Dienes_1976"/>
